summary: 0.22.0 ships and a consumer upgrades to it by one version bump plus the release's migration note, its standing queue still readable and its loop still running
acceptance: a consumer on an earlier version bumps to 0.22.0, follows the release's migration note and nothing else, and its loop runs to hibernation: the queue it already carries parses after the note's steps, and no run ends over a parse failure a sibling slice has already repaired
notes: Operator record, 2026-10-07; the only standing goal. Outside the loop: the 0.22.0 cut and cartograph's upgrade (~157 entries carrying the retired `priority` key, two ticks at once). The abort half is open as `does-a-69-whose-cause-a-sibling-repaired-still-abort-the-run.md` — the spec sentence moves before any code can. The `priority` strip is the note's one line, so nothing is filed for it. The cut itself stays the interactive session's (`CLAUDE.md`, *Release cut*).
